headline: 《希望》领跑银幕，《龙族》燃屏
summary: 今日电影《希望》口碑票房双领跑，《生死时限》悬疑受热议；剧集方面《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续霸榜，《菜鸟老警》亦获好评。待映片单中《猫鼬》《生化危机：爆发夜》备受期待。

industryHighlights.text: 《希望》《生死时限》占据本周电影热榜前列，类型互补。
industryHighlights.en: 'Hope' and 'Deadline' top this week's film charts with contrasting genres.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》稳居剧集热度榜首，吸睛无数。
industryHighlights.en: 'House of the Dragon' remains the hottest series, capturing huge attention.

industryHighlights.text: 《猫鼬》《生化危机：爆发夜》待映话题度高，市场期待升温。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films 'Meerkat' and 'Resident Evil: Night of Outbreak' are generating strong anticipation.

industryHighlights.text: 《菜鸟老警》《黑色丽人》等热播剧持续丰富观众选择。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series like 'The Rookie' and 'Black Beauty' continue to diversify viewer options.

headlineEn: 'Hope' Leads Films, 'Dragon Clan' Heats Up TV
summaryEn: Film 'Hope' leads with strong buzz, while thriller 'Deadline' sparks discussion; on TV, 'House of the Dragon' dominates charts and 'The Rookie' wins praise. Upcoming titles 'Meerkat' and 'Resident Evil: Night of Outbreak' are highly anticipated.
